overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board approved the May 22, June 5, and June 18 minutes at its July 17 meeting, within the timely-approval window under 940 CMR 29.11.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to approve its May 22, June 5, and June 18 meeting minutes in a timely manner.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, minutes of all three meetings were timely approved within the later of the next three meetings or 30 days.
